title: [NBL27 Round 6] Free Hungry Jack's Cheeseburger (in-Store or via Drive-Thru) or with $1 Minimum Spend Online @ Hungry Jack's App
body:
Deal: [NBL27 Round 6] Free Hungry Jack's Cheeseburger (in-Store or via Drive-Thru) or with $1 Minimum Spend Online @ Hungry Jack's App

[new2onlineshopping] For those who prefer to manually enter it in the NBL app, or directly on the NBL website, here , the codeword for this afternoon's game (Cairns Taipans v New Zealand Breakers) is GUTS.
[HFT] was unable to redeem via counter at the Fyshwick, ACT store last week.
The person stated that their scanner wasn't working so they needed to manually enter the offer numbers into the point-of-sale machine.
When the code was entered the first time, the salesperson said the machine gave an error.
The second time that the code was entered, the person said that the voucher didn't reduce the price for a cheeseburger. The person asked their manager, who said that the offer was unavailable.
My guess is that the store's franchisee agreement likely results in them incurring a cost for providing the promotion, so they have an incentive to reduce redemptions.
[new2onlineshopping] Yes, I find staff at some stores are being dodgy about this offer - last round, at one store they claimed that (after scanning the barcode) I had already redeemed the free cheeseburger. Which I had not. But then the very same barcode was scanned at a second store about five minutes later (there are two HJ stores at Southern Cross station in Melbourne), and I was able to get the free cheeseburger without any issues. So clearly the staff at the first store just didn't want to give away the free food… 💩
[safrane] I think it got too popular to the point where they're being bombarded with having to make free cheeseburgers for so many people, especially in stores like Southern Cross, that they're delaying legit paying customers, like those who needed to catch a train.
I'm pretty sure the managers in quieter stores don't really care as it's a deal that goes through head office.
[new2onlineshopping] So maybe I should stop posting the direct link in future rounds? 😉
[safrane] @new2onlineshopping: Let's just say that when I was redeeming the free cheeseburger at Southern Cross (I have 5 phones, don't judge me), there were multiple other people also waiting for free cheeseburgers.
[new2onlineshopping] @safrane: FIVE phones? You got a free cheeseburger for each phone? That's impressive. 👏👏👏
[safrane] @new2onlineshopping: 1 for me,1 for work ,1 for Felix unlimited internet at home (I remote desktop when away), 1 in the car just for Waze, and 1 Samsung S23 Ultra with a smashed-up screen which I use with Dex.
[Jshy] I believe the store that you claim the voucher with cops the loss. One of the managers told me that they bear the cost of all the free vouchers and discounts for customers (like birthday Whopper). Not sure if this varies from store to store.
[safrane] @Jshy: I would be surprised (and it would be stupid) if nationwide promos run by head office would affect the store's KPIs.
But Birthday Whoppers might as you've said, as it's more 'incidental'.
[Jshy] In the past, when my voucher did not work, they deducted the cost as a "store loss", as written on the receipt. Probably depends on the branch but I would assume all managers have the ability to do this if they're bothered/willing to.
[Tommohalby] Couldn't figure out why it didn't work for me.
This comment
Let me know if this method stops working - as per comment from jcguy7, iOS users will need to turn off DNS ad blocking for this to work on iPhones.
Made me think maybe my pihole also has been blocking. Yep it has. Stop pihole, do your steps = free burger success. I'm android so maybe a general rule if not working to switch off pihole etc and try again. 👍
[new2onlineshopping] Glad to hear you figured out how to make it work for you. :)
[pennypacker42069] is this Queensland only? I entered the code GUTS and a NSW postcode but then the email I received says the voucher can only be used in Queensland
[new2onlineshopping] The voucher loaded into the HJ app can be used at ANY store, Australia-wide. In previous rounds, the emails have also stated different states depending on which teams were playing, but those vouchers worked in any state.
[jeffr] worked in Qld - will try to redeem tomorrow
